data.name: Xilva
data.description: Xilva is a Zurich-based startup (founded 2021) that provides due diligence, rating, and monitoring services for forest and nature-based carbon removal projects. Its GRADE, SCREEN and MONITOR tools help investors and offtakers assess risk and quality of afforestation/reforestation and REDD+ projects. Xilva is not itself a carbon remover but a ratings/MRV platform in the CDR ecosystem.
